parameter_scope: Exact F324 public pairs are reused. Only N and Jacobi-positive a enter the direct Gauss pairing. b appears solely in the retained F322 reference. Offline p,q label and verify outputs only.

small_exact_checks.scope: All odd N through 101 and all unit a<=16. Gauss parity uses an independent trial-factor Jacobi oracle. Full domain, rank/select, F, decoder, auxiliary, and path checks use every Jacobi-positive case.

validation_scope: Explicit domain construction and lookup validate rank/select calls. Their time is separate and is not charged as algorithm work.
